chunks: 5609 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who died and left behind his daughter and his full sister, he عليه السلام said: "The wealth belongs to the daughter, and the sister from the father and mother has no share at all."

key_terms.الْأُخْتِ مِنَ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ: the full sister, related through both father and mother
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: any share or portion at all

ai.seo_question: If a man dies leaving a daughter and a full sister, who inherits the estate?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance when a deceased man leaves behind a daughter and a full sister. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام states that the estate belongs to the daughter, while the full sister receives no share in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5609 - It is narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who passed away and left behind his daughter and his full sister (sister from his father and mother).
Imam (as) said: "The wealth belongs to the daughter, and the full sister has no share in it."
